fix(codeon): restore reject-close uniqueness and keep attempts progressing after restart (#42)

* fix(codeon): make RejectClose uniqueness per review operation

* fix(codeon): keep attempt progressing after daemon startup reconciliation

Startup reconciliation ticks an executing attempt once but never enqueues
a followup wakeup, so multi-tick flows (e.g. RejectClose intent ->
receipt -> completion) stall after a daemon restart once the wakeup
chain is exhausted. Mirror the tick loop: enqueue a followup wakeup
whenever a startup-reconciled tick reports progress.
